items.text: Qahal as ONE primitive with graduated capability surface (Commons/Engaged/Contributor/Steward/Commons-Elohim layers); no binary membership flag, continuous curve computed per-request
Two earned axes: Reach (outward content visibility, per-audience) + Standing (inward capability within a Qahal, per-Qahal); both computed not assigned, both revocable

Standing function: compute_standing(human, qahal, as_of) derived view (Category C) from lamad mastery attestations + affinity signals - feedback debits, weighted by rubric version + friction-gradient flattening -> Bloom-tiered capability surface
Bloom-graded mastery curve (Remember/Understand/Apply/Analyze/Evaluate/Create) mapped to capability surfaces; Steward = Bloom-Create = capacity to author the rubric (recursive)

Rubric as governable versioned EPR authored by stewards (not protocol); RubricUpdates link chain; specifies Bloom-tier mappings, attestation requirements, affinity weights, feedback debit rules, friction thresholds, commons-elohim defaults
Anti-colonization by construction: mastery-attested gate cannot be hijacked by a bad-faith insider (must become legible to collective values); rubric updates require Bloom-Create under prior rubric

Commons-elohim co-steward per Qahal: instantiated at genesis, structurally embedded (cannot be silenced), holds commons-share custody, speaks in councils, mediates disputes, witnesses standing, speaks for bioregion in natural collectives

Friction-gradient limitarianism: soft (diminishing standing returns + commons-share absorbs residual + curve flattening) + hard (protocol refuses concentration ops + council validation for centralizing rubric updates); recursive across wisdom layer
Standing decay as innate process (demurrage/stepping-back), cadence-archetype-tunable per rubric; past contributions honored in record, current standing honest about current participation

Substrate composition: Qahal = Layer-0 identity-anchor EPR; rubric coupled via QahalToRubric; commons-elohim via QahalToCommonsElohim (atomic); memberships as couplings; sub-Qahals via QahalToSubQahal; federation via shared commons-elohim (no new graph primitive)

Three-layer Qahal lifecycle (Layer0 Identity / Layer1 Specification / Layer2 Process) pay-as-you-grow; lifecycle_stage enum (Ideation/Specification/Active/Hibernating/Succession/EndOfLife); cradle-to-grave permanence (no delete, archival only)
Five truths per Qahal event (Who/What/When/Why on DHT, How on libp2p); all must resolve to substrate or interpretability has failed

Composition with all pillars: imagodei (lensed members) + lamad (attestation quizzes) + shefa (value cascades/Agreements/commons-share) + mishpat (governance EPRs) + elohim (commons-elohim/councils) + doorway (web2 projection)

MVP exit: median steward (Matthew + household + faith community + life-group + wisdom-commons federation) opens app, sees convergent Qahal homepage, takes lamad-attested quiz earning standing, witnesses capability expand, sees commons-elohim right-nav view; seed Dowell household + Bay Area Dawn Runners

MVP sprint sequence (0-5): vision consolidation / homepage UX (graphos) / substrate spine schema (schema-first) / substrate wire-up (Qahal+rubric+standing+commons-elohim stub) / frontend wire-up (Library B->backend) / genesis content+templates+a2o

Carried-forward open questions: friction-gradient enforcement mix; commons-elohim runtime location; rubric versioning model; standing caching strategy; manifest tooling-tray composability; imagodei lens recursion; DNA placement (mishpat ~11/100 working assumption); bioregional non-human stakeholder; ephemeral merge contracts; layered arbitration-council convening
